subject: DataCorp: VPC <> On‑Prem bridging + term alignment
messages:
From: Leah Ramos <leah.ramos@datacorp.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@datacorp.com, daniel.birch@datacorp.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync about private footprint and term 

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the overview last week. We had a follow-up with infra about the isolation ask: the compliance team wants a physically isolated on‑prem cluster in our Frankfurt DC plus VPC peering into our EU tenant for low‑latency failover. That will likely be an expansion to the existing draft SOW.

Key constraints:
- Must be air‑gapped except for a single egress tunnel for telemetry to Redwood (filtered)
- Separate KMS for keys in on‑prem environment
- 24x7 runbook for failover from VPC to on‑prem for the EU region

Can you send a version of the SOW that calls out the on‑prem cluster spec and an estimate for add'l monthly reserved capacity for the dedicated GPUs? Also, our procurement lead (cc'd) wants to align term dates — we prefer all contracts to end 2028‑12‑31 to simplify renewals.

Regards,
Leah
Director, Infrastructure
DataCorp
From: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Leah Ramos <leah.ramos@datacorp.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, procurement@datacorp.com, daniel.birch@datacorp.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync about private footprint and term 

Leah —

Thanks, this is clear and helpful. I pulled the current SOW and sketched three options to cover lifecycle and term alignment:

Option A — Minimal add: single on‑prem cluster (4x A100-equivalent), VPC peering, 12‑month extension to align to 2028‑12‑31. No managed KMS (customer-managed).
Estimated delta: $28,500/mo reserved + one‑time onboarding fee $45,000.

Option B — Hardened: air‑gapped on‑prem with filtered telemetry, Redwood-managed standby replica, managed KMS (customer key escrow). 24x7 runbook and quarterly DR tests.
Estimated delta: $46,000/mo reserved + one‑time $78,000.

Option C — Full managed plus SLA uplift: includes proactive warm standby across two on‑prem racks, extended support, and expedited failover playbooks.
Estimated delta: $68,500/mo reserved + one‑time $120,000.

I attached the updated SOW stub and an architecture diagram that draws the peering and the single egress telemetry tunnel (priv‑vpc‑architecture-diagram.png).

Quick asks so we can finalize pricing:
1) Which option best matches compliance needs?
2) Do you want Redwood to run KMS (managed) or do you need to keep KMS fully behind your HSM?
3) Any blackout windows for installation in July/Aug?

If you prefer, we can schedule a 30‑minute call with our infra leads (Aditya and Monica) this week.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, karl.ops@datacorp.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: notes for DataCorp on‑prem spec

Sofia — quick internal notes to reference on the call:
- For an air‑gapped on‑prem install we'll need a 2‑week hardware prep and a 5‑day onsite install window (unless we use remote hands).
- Telemetry tunnel: recommend mTLS with IP allowlist and egress proxy; only tokenized metrics (no PII).
- KMS: if customer insists on HSM-only, we can support bring‑your‑own‑KMS but it adds ~2 weeks to the go‑live and triggers higher onboarding professional fees.
- DR tests: automated smoke failover via our routing policy; we need a test window and a cutover SLT.

I'll join the customer call and be prepared to walk the runbook.

— Aditya
Eng, Private Deployments
From: Leah Ramos <leah.ramos@datacorp.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@datacorp.com, daniel.birch@datacorp.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync about private footprint and term 

Sofia —

Thanks for the options. Compliance is leaning toward Option B (Hardened). They insist on customer‑managed HSM for keys but are open to Redwood operating the runtime. Blackout windows: July 19–23 and Aug 9–11 for quarterly system work on our side.

Procurement (Eric) wants a consolidated contract end date of 2028‑12‑31 and a fixed cap on monthly overages. Can you include a 15% overage cap in the SOW pricing, and note it applies only to token usage, not one‑time fees?

Also: send a separate quote line for the one‑time onboarding fees so procurement can route it to CAPEX vs OPEX buckets.

-Leah
From: monica.patel@redwood.com <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Leah Ramos <leah.ramos@datacorp.com>, sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:57:00 -07:00
Subject: SOW v2 (Option B) + migration runbook draft

Leah / team —

Attached: DataCorp_SOW_v2.pdf and migration‑runbook.md (high level). Highlights in this draft:
- Option B scope with air‑gap requirements, telemetry egress controls, and managed standby replica.
- KMS: we added an appendix for customer HSM integration steps and a 10‑day extension to onboarding timeline for HSM validation.
- Overage cap: included a token usage overage cap of 15% with pre‑approved throttles; excess beyond cap billed monthly.
- Term: we added language to pro‑rata the add‑on so the entire contract expires 2028‑12‑31 if signed by 2027‑07‑31.

Next steps: 1) Leah — confirm procurement split (one‑time vs recurring) so we can line‑item them. 2) Eric — if you can send PO template or preferred vendor details we will populate the order form. 3) Requesting a go‑live blackout avoid window — we will not schedule installs during your listed blackout dates.

Note: I've also listed the proposed installation week of Aug 23–27 to avoid your blackout dates and to allow HSM validation.

— Monica
Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Eric Wong <procurement@datacorp.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: Leah Ramos <leah.ramos@datacorp.com>, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOW v2 (Option B) + migration runbook draft

Monica / Sofia —

Thanks for the detailed SOW. Procurement reviewed and we have two quick items before we route to legal:
1) Please include a single consolidated invoice schedule and a breakdown that shows the one‑time onboarding as CAPEX line (we will supply PO code once you confirm).
2) For SLAs: we need an uptime SLA for the managed standby replica (target 99.5%) and an explicit rollback clause for failed DR tests.

If you can update the SOW with the invoice schedule and SLA clause, we will generate the PO and sign via DocuSign. Also confirm the final one‑time onboarding amount will remain as listed in the attachment; procurement needs a hard number for budget approval.

I'll expect the updated doc and a DocuSign link.

— Eric

DataCorp
